mission.comment: Firewolf are raring for a comeback tour before retiring to live off of the proceeds.
mission.name: Metal to the Masses
mission.IntroText: Fifteen years ago Firewolf were at the zenith of their career. They packed arenas and ruled the sales charts.\n   Of late the band enjoys only very modest success but Firewolf are on the comeback trail and hire you to manage their final recording and farewell.
mission.SucceedText: Well done! Firewolf's farewell tour was what dreams are made of and you took a band from yester-year to the youth of today.\n   You are name dropped in awe throughout backstage areas the world over.
mission.FailText: Bitter and disappointed Firewolf sack you as manager.\n   They invested savings on a grand sortie into the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but your incompetence means Firewolf will spend the rest of their lives as entertainers in third class strip joints.\n   Try again making sure you have a successful album out before attempting a world tour.
mission.CriteriaText:
 Get a Record Deal 
 Release an Album 
 Sell 25 000 Copies 
 Go on a World Tour (minimum three stops)

triggers.ExecuteThis: [[#if, ["GetNumUpComingEventsOfType(#Concert) == 0", [[#if, ["missionVar.Date == me.TriggerActivateDate + 14", [[#if, ["percentChance(50)", ["tmp = ¤#RMCEddie"], ["tmp = ¤#RMCSonny"]]], "EventCard(#ECOCMis5WorldsLoudestMad,tmp)"]]], [#if, ["missionVar.Date == me.TriggerActivateDate + 21", ["EventCard(#ECOCMis5WorldsLoudestFury, ¤#RMCSonny)", "Me.Activate(0)"]]]], ["tmpConcert = GetNextUpComingEventOfType(#Concert)", [#if, ["tmpConcert.StartDate <= me.TriggerActivateDate +21", ["MissionVar.AndyImune = 1", "EventCard(#ECOCMis5WorldsLoudestNews,tmp)", "Activate(#TRMis5WorldsLoudesthappy)", "Me.Activate(0)"], [[#if, ["missionVar.MyConcert != tmpConcert.Startdate", ["missionVar.MyConcert  = tmpConcert.Startdate", "EventCard(#ECOCMis5WorldsLoudestPlaySooner,tmp)"]]]]]]]]]]

cards.comment: City News print an article indicating that Firewolf might be breaking up. After a long period of internal conflict, they now have decided go separate ways, it says.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Firewolf Break Up?
cards.Caption: Firewolf Break Up Beef Killed Music
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: <¤CBand.name> causes a minor political crisis when the press reports that the Trade Minister's wife spent the night in <¤CRealMusician.name>'s hotel room.\n\tIt will likely result in divorce and the minister leaving office. Oh well!
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Minister's Wife Parties with Band
cards.question: Band causes scandal

cards.comment: The band finds <¤CRealmusician.name> unconscious following a drug overdose.\n\tYou manage to wake him up, but he definitely needs medical attention in order to survive.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> OD
cards.Caption: Overdozed
cards.question: Who do you call first?

cards.comment: Eddie has changed his lifestyle completely. Now he demands that all food being served to him be biodynamically produced, contain no meat and be rinsed in spring water before cooking.\n\tHis new lifestyle is costly and he demands you raise his pay.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Eddie St Jones on Whole Grain Diet
cards.Caption: Healthy lifestyle
cards.question: Give Eddie $500/week raise?

cards.comment: Sonny has met a girl. Her name is Anette and they are very fond of each other. He says she gives him inspiration and calls her his muse.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Finds Love
cards.Caption: Sweet looove of mine
cards.question: Sonny van Lord is in love

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf's music should be harder. She says that nobody likes soft music anymore.\n\tSonny says she's right, but the rest of the band don't seem to agree.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Girlfriend with an Opinion
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf should have a more spectacular stage show.\n\tSome fire, maybe a few dancers and guest artist should do the trick.\n\tSonny thinks that Anette's idea is great, but the rest of the band don't seem to agree.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Girlfriend with an Opinion
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette is disappointed with the media attention lately.\n\tShe thinks that the band members can't handle reporters and that Sonny doesn't get enough attention.\n\tShe suggests that Sonny becomes Firewolf's spokesman in future interviews.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette's Pointers on Interviews
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> met Lola Hertz at a party recently. <¤CRealMusician.firstname> flirted with her in hopes that she would play their songs more often.\n\tIn a dark corner of the party, they let one thing lead to another. Not before long, they were licking each other's ears!\n\tWhen Lola asked <¤CRealMusician.firstname> if he wanted to come back to her place to see some of her etchings, <¤CRealMusician.firstname> got cold feet, saying it was because Lola has such ugly eyebrows!
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Hurts Lola of Radio FM
cards.Caption: Sensitive
cards.question: Radio FM hasn't played any <¤Cband.name> songs since

cards.comment: A woman in the audience was hit in the eye by a Mortensen drumstick that slipped from Manny's hand during your recent concert.\n\tApparently, Mortensen drumsticks have extremely low surface friction and therefore easily slip.\n\tThe doctor says she will be OK, but the lady threatens to sue the band for pain and suffering.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Woman Injured in Concert
cards.Caption: <¤Cplace.name>
cards.question: Pay settlement ($10.000) or go to court?

cards.comment: Firewolf are furious that you would try to change their band name. They immediately change it back and warn you about trying anything like that again.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Firewolf Refuse Name Change
cards.Caption: Mad Eddie
cards.question: Firewolf won't change

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> has recovered from his overdose and is back to business as usual.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> Back on Track
cards.Caption: Well again
cards.question: Andy's back

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> is urgently ill. His doctor sends him to detox because he had a whole pharmacy in his system.\n\t<¤CrealMusician.name> will be out for at least a month.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> at Detox
cards.Caption: Off to the clinic
cards.question: <¤CrealMusician.name> won't be around for some time

cards.comment: The court frees <¤CrealMusician.name> from all charges of abuse, possession and trafficking of drugs.\n\tHis lawyer said Andy's conscience "is as white as snow." That decided things as far as the court was concerned.\n\tAlso, you spot Sergey's car outside the judge's office.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> Free of Charges
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin
cards.question: Andy's free

cards.comment: The court sentences Andy Rokks to four years incarceration for drug-related activity.\n\tThe motivation behind the sentencing was the organized distribution of drugs at Springfield Elementary School (where both school yard attendants and the students' council where part of the business).\n\tAndy won't be able to play with Firewolf for a few years.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: Jailhouse Rock
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Following Andy Rokks' drug offence, the PTA demand that record shops stop selling all Firewolf records.\n\t"Will Firewolf take responsibility if our children become drug addicts? Of course not, they are only interested in money!" says PTA chairman Ed Stone on Radio FM News.
cards.name: The Parent Teacher Association
cards.Headline: PTA Ban Record
cards.Caption: Ed Stone
cards.question: Stop sales of <¤Calbum.name>?

cards.comment: City News run a full page on Andy Rokks drug dealing enterprise.\n\tThe article states that the police found elementary school student directories in Andy's apartment, and that the words "Lick Here" are printed on the inside of Firewolf's record sleeves.\n\tAndy Rokks is, according to City News' sources, cousin of the infamous drug baron Il Conte who has used him to recruit new customers.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Artist Sold Drugs to School Children
cards.Caption: Rock Star Sold Drugs to Children
cards.question: Andy made the papers

cards.comment: Eddie St. Johns has slept with Sonny van Lord's girlfriend. They took their chance when Sonny went to the guitar shop to buy strings.\n\tSonny van Lord says he's going to tear Eddie's guts out  literally!\n\tIt might take some time before they can work together again.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Infidelity and Discord
cards.Caption: Couldn't stay away from the honey jar
cards.question: Sonny and Eddie beef

cards.comment: The Parent Teacher Association recommends that record buyers boycott <¤Cband.name> because band musician, <¤CRealmusician.name>, asked audience members during a live show if there were any girls in the crowd who wanted to go backstage and "play his flute."\n\tThe PTA wants everybody who cares for the future of their daughters to avoid the band.
cards.name: The Parent Teacher Association
cards.Headline: PTA Boycott Firewolf
cards.Caption: Let it all hang out
cards.question: PTA suggest boycott

cards.comment: The Promoter claims the demands in your sixty-page rider are preposterous.\n\tIt would cost him $10.000 to heat the venue ahead of time, and you would have to pay for that yourself.\n\tThe alphabet crackers he can arrange, though.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Promoter Contests Demands
cards.Caption: Huge heating bill
cards.question: Pay the $10.000?

cards.comment: Manny Swift pinched one of Sonny van Lord's guitars. Sonny got it back when he threatened to piss in Manny's bass drum, but now the guitar sounds strange.\n\tSonny is grumpy and doesn't want to rehearse.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Manny Swift Nicks Guitar
cards.Caption: Bullied
cards.question: Sonny sulks

cards.comment: Manny Swift only wants to stay in and read all the time, while the rest of Firewolf are busy pouring liquor over each other in night clubs. The band worries about Manny.\n\tManny himself explains that he finds reading more rewarding than drinking.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Manny Likes to Read
cards.Caption: Likes to read
cards.question: Manny won't rock

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord has been infected with a sexually transmitted disease.\n\tIt will go away with a bit of penicillin, but Sonny is so ashamed he doesn't want to be seen in public for a while.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Sonny Ill
cards.Caption: Infected
cards.question: Sonny lays low

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord threatens to leave Firewolf. He has had it with the criticism against Anette and says that love is more important than music.\n\tSonny says he can't understand how Firewolf can take Anette's well-meaning advice as criticism. He thinks the rest of the band are ungrateful idiots.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Sonny Threatens to Leave Band
cards.Caption: Outta here
cards.question: Sonny threatens leave the band

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord wants to apologise to Firewolf. He has broken up with Anette and regrets that he fought with the band. He apologises for the harsh words.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Back to Square One
cards.Caption: Business as usual again
cards.question: Accept Sonny's apology?

cards.comment: <¤CBand.name>'s new video receives massive media attention.\n\tUnfortunately, it's not a music video, but a film of the band having a liquor and sex orgy with a dozen fans in a hotel room.\n\tNobody knows who shot it, but now it's everywhere.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Wrong Video Makes the News
cards.Caption: Wrong vid
cards.question: What can you do?

cards.comment: The police have apprehended Sonny van Lord at the Mirror Ball men's room where he was having sexual intercourse with another man.\n\tA field day for the press, the pictures of the men being brought out of the nightclub in handcuffs are all over.\n\tSonny is later released without consequences.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Sonny Arrested
cards.Caption: Rock Star had Sex with other Man
cards.question: Sonny came out with a bang

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Manny Swift is not a good enough drummer to be playing with Firewolf.\n\tShe thinks that you should find a better drummer.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette Suggests Change
cards.Caption: Anette
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: The show is delayed because <¤CRealMusician.name> is "sick to his stomach" and vomits in the dressing room for two hours.\n\tThe crowd waits patiently, but when Firewolf finally go on stage, the atmosphere is tense.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Delayed Show
cards.Caption: Sick place
cards.question: Two hours' delay

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name>'s long hair catches in the strings of his guitar.\n\tThe sound engineer runs up with a pair of scissors and cuts loose <¤Crealmusician.firstname>, who finishes the gig with hurt pride.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: <¤Crealmusician.firstname> Caught in Guitar
cards.Caption: Rough cut
cards.question: <¤Crealmusician.firstname>'s hair caught

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord can't find his guitar tuner. It's missing and Sonny doesn't have time to tune his guitars properly before the gig.\n\tAfterwards, the band discovers that Manny hid the tuner, and the band blames him for the disastrous show.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Guitar Tuner Stolen
cards.Caption: No thingy
cards.question: Domestic fight

cards.comment: The record label gives you a letter from some young fans. They are a bunch of ten year olds who send pictures of themselves dressed as <¤CBand.name>.\n\tThe band feel very honoured.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fan Mail
cards.Caption: Popular
cards.question: <¤CBand.name> are down with the kids

cards.comment: Some fans call to say that they have made a fansite for <¤CBand.Name>. Now they want an interview with the band.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Request Interview
cards.question: Give interview?

cards.comment: The fans that made the fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can get some free tickets to your next show. It would cost <formatCurrency(tmp)>.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want Tickets
cards.question: Pay <formatCurrency(tmp)>?

cards.comment: The fans that made the fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can have a few free copies of your new record.\n\tThey want to post a review of the record, and give away copies as prizes for a contest they are holding on their site.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want Records
cards.question: Give $500 worth of records?

cards.comment: The fans that did a fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can get some backstage passes for your next show. They feel they've become so close to the band now, that they would like to meet them at the backstage party.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want Backstage Passes
cards.question: Give them backstage passes?

cards.comment: The fans that made a fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can travel with <Cband.Name> on the tour. \n  They feel they've really connected with the band and want to tag along on tour.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want to Go on Tour
cards.question: Let them join?

cards.comment: Notorious instrument maker Mortensen offers <¤Cband.name> $45000 if they use Mortensen gear on all their official appearances.\n\tMortensen are known for subpar quality, but it might be worth the extra dough.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Sponsor Offer
cards.Caption: Mortensen
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> complains that drunken strangers are hanging out in their tour bus all the time.\n\tThe band can't sleep, read, play cards or solve crossword puzzles because of the noise.\n\t<¤CBand.name> are too old to party twenty-four-seven, but this crowd doesn't seem to care.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Fans on the Road
cards.Caption: <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.question: Ask the fans to leave?

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> says he's had it with all the people hanging out in their dressing room at every gig. \n\tHe wants to know where they all come from and why they always drink all the beer.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> Wants some Peace and Quiet
cards.Caption: Angry <¤CrealMusician.firstname>
cards.question: <¤CRealMusician.firstname>'s had it

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> wants to add some extra magic to the show.\n\tHalfway into the gig {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} produces a frog from a box and bites it's head off, much to the crowd's delight.\n\tSoon thereafter {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} begins to vomit and has to leave the stage for an ambulance ride to the emergency room where {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>, #Genitive:1]} stomach is pumped out.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> in Hospital
cards.Caption: Frogeater
cards.question: Don't eat raw frogs

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord feels you have treated his girlfriend Anette unjustly. You say you like her ideas, but you don't act on it.\n\tHe gets the impression you don't really respect her, which means you don't respect him and his skills as a guitarist.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Sonny Disappointed
cards.Caption: Rightly mad
cards.question: You should show some respect!

cards.comment: Andy Rokks has had a psychosis.\n\tAfter emergency electric shock treatment at the hospital, he decides to move back in with his mum and live the safe life with milk and cookies everyday.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Andy Moves Back Home
cards.Caption: Nuts
cards.question: Andy Rokks leaves Firewolf

cards.comment: Halfway through the show, Sonny van Lord changes guitars. When he strikes the first chord on the new guitar, a flash shoots out from the amp.\n\tSonny falls down unconscious and the guitar is on fire. The show ends early, and the promoter only pays half.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Sonny Shocked
cards.Caption: Accidents happen so easily
cards.question: Sonny electrified

cards.comment: Andy Rokks returns from detoxification. He looks a little better, but you should look after him closely.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Andy Back from Detox
cards.Caption: No more tox
cards.question: Andy's back

cards.comment: During practice, Firewolf suddenly stops playing to watch Sonny van Lord's hair stand on end and see electric sparks shoot from his fingers.\n\tThe band laughs, but when Sonny's eyebrows smoke you realise he's in real trouble.\n\tYou push him away from the Mortensen amplifier that is sending electric shocks through his body.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Electrifying Practice Session
cards.Caption: Bzzzz
cards.question: Sonny escapes with a few burned hairs

cards.comment: You agreed to let Firewolf attempt to set a new volume record, but you still haven't booked a show.\n\tThe band are becoming frustrated, because they're eager to play loud.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Record Attempt Requires Show
cards.Caption: <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.question: Come on, book a date

cards.comment: You still haven't booked a concert for the volume record attempt. Firewolf are so disappointed that they fire you as their manager.\n\tNow they'll find somebody who believes in breaking the sound barrier with them.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: No Gig, No Band
cards.question: You're fired

cards.comment: The publicity for the high volume record attempt works well. City News runs a big story on the upcoming attempt at the volume record.\n\tThey also give a history of high volume records and host an interview with sound scientist Ian Agrosenius, who explains the scientific challenge in creating very loud sounds.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: World Record Attempt Makes the News
cards.Caption: Loudest Band Take  on Volume Record
cards.question: City News seem to like the idea

cards.comment: The band says the next gig is too far off. Someone else could break the record before that  they have even heard a rumor that Fatal Death are trying.\n\tYou should hurry up and book a gig.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Gig Too Late
cards.Caption: <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.question: Hurry before someone else beats you to it

cards.comment: Firewolf play in g-suits to an overly enthusiastic crowd wearing state of the art ear plugs.\n\tAn official measures a record-shattering 165 dB during Eddie's one minute sustained high note. That's way over the previously set record. The entire concert was louder than the old record!\n\tThe city spends weeks cleaning up the broken glass from the surrounding buildings.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: 165 dB World Record
cards.Caption: 165 dB's of pure metal
cards.question: You made it!

cards.comment: Bitter and disappointed, Firewolf fire you as their manager.\n\tThey put their last savings on a grand sortie from the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but now it's all gone.\n\tThanks to you they'll have to spend the rest of their lives playing third class strip bars.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Firewolf Broke
cards.Caption: Firewolf Fire Manager - The End of Metal?

cards.comment: Try again and spend your cash more wisely this time.\n\tMake sure your concerts are successful by keeping your band happy before the gigs.\n\tCarefully market your record and work the media for free press.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment:
Bitter and disappointed, Firewolf fire you as their manager.
	They put their last savings on a grand sortie from the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but now it's all gone.
	Thanks to you they'll have to spend the rest of their lives playing third class strip bars.
	Try again and do better.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Firewolf Give Up
cards.Caption: Firewolf Fire Manager  The End of Metal?

cards.comment: Try again and do better. Make sure you have a successful album out before you embark on a world tour. Do lots of PR and marketing to promote sales.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: <¤Crealmusician.name> has left the band and there's just no way the rest of them are going to continue without him.\n\tThey might fight at times, but Firewolf just wouldn't be Firewolf without the original members.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Firewolf Give Up

cards.comment: Rule 1A: Keep the band happy. Use any means necessary  gifts, booze, holidays, whatever.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: The last gig was a total failure and Firewolf want to make sure that does not happen again.\n\tFifteen years ago, Firewolf were on the front pages of papers all over the world after a record smashing 130 dB concert at Colosseum. Now, with the help of advanced technology, they feel it's time to set new standards for concert volume.\n\tMortensen special equipment and protective gear for another record attempt would set you back $10.000.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Crank It Up!
cards.Caption: Time to challenge the 130 dB record.
cards.question: Challenge the Volume Record at Next Show?

cards.comment: Firewolf are really happy with their last gig, in fact they're so happy they want to do something extra for their next show.\n\tFifteen years ago, Firewolf were on the front pages of papers all over the world after a record shattering 130 dB concert at Colosseum. Now, with the help of advanced technology, they feel it's time to set new standards for concert volume.\n\tSpecial equipment and protective gear for the new attempt would set you back $10.000.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Crank It Up!
cards.Caption: Time to challenge the 130 dB record.
cards.question: Challenge the Volume Record at Next Show?

cards.comment: You meet to prepare for the concert, but Andy doesn't show. Time passes and you don't hear anything from him.\n\tAfter waiting, you have to cancel the show. Still nobody seems to know where Andy is at.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Rokks Missing
cards.Caption: Mad at Andy
cards.question: Andy's disappeared

cards.comment: The next day, Andy is back. He says he has no idea what happened.\n\tHe doesn't remember anything and doesn't seem to care that the show was cancelled.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Rokks Back
cards.Caption: Won't remember
cards.question: Andy's back

cards.comment: Andy Rokks doesn't dare leave his hotel room, because Jolly Roger of The Pirates has said that he's going to kick Andy's ass.\n\tAndy tells the horror tale of how The Pirates manhandled singer/song-writer Eric Flanders at last years Monsters of Mud.\n\tAndy is insecure whether he dares play or not.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Is Scared
cards.Caption: Small and scared
cards.question: Cancel show?

cards.comment: The Pirates are up front yelling profanity during the first half of the gig.\n\tThen Jolly Roger slips in the mud and hits his head on the crowd barrier. They leave.\n\tAndy escapes without a scratch.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: The Pirates Disturb Concert
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: Andy made it

cards.comment: When you arrive to Monsters of Mud you have to wait in line for three hours to get the stage passes. Nobody knows where you are supposed to stay.\n\tThe band leaves you with all the gear to find accommodating groupie-campers.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Practical Matters
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: You sleep in the car

cards.comment: When <¤Cband.name> is going on stage there's no electricity. The gig is delayed 45 minutes.\n\tTo keep the night's schedule, you shorten your set and end up being on stage for twelve minutes.\n\tThe crowd boos and the band sulks.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Delay
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: Short gig today

cards.comment: The threats from Jolly Roger made quite an impact on poor Andy. He just sits in the dressing room staring blindly into the mirror.\n\tAndy trembles like a leaf, spilling drinks and breaking things.\n\tThere's is no way Andy's gonna play tonight.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Rokks Refuses to Play
cards.Caption: Scared witless
cards.question: Show cancelled

cards.comment: Rock festival Monsters of Mud wants to book you for a gig at this year's event.\n\tThey offer $5000 and you'll be gone for a week.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Invitation to Rock Festival
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: You in?

cards.comment: You take a closer look at the line up for Monsters of Mud and realise <¤Cband.name> are not playing the second biggest stage like you had been promised.\n\tInstead, they're set to play at a remote tent stage early in the afternoon, between two circus acts.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Wrong Stage
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: Just before the end of the show, something strange happens. Eddie St. Johns pushes Manny Swift's drums over and hits him in the head with a cymbal.\n\tThen the whole band jump in and take turns beating the crap out of Manny with instruments, microphone stands and amplifiers.\n\tAfterwards nobody wants to talk about it, but Manny has to stay in the hospital for a few days.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Firewolf Manhandle Drummer
cards.Caption: Bruises all over
cards.question: Manny got beat

cards.comment: Firewolf have started a contest amongst each other about who can take most groupie scalps.\n\tAside the glory and the odd crab, the winner gets nothing in particular.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Groupie Contest
cards.question: Tell the press?

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> has started a sort of bonus system to make the roadies get him groupies.\n\tBefore every gig he gives out backstage passes with the roadies' names on. The owner of the backstage pass on the floor of <¤CrealMusician.firstname>'s room the next morning gets $100 and a crate of beer.\n\tEverybody wins, says <¤CrealMusician.firstname>.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Bonus System for the Roadies
cards.Caption: Desirable
cards.question: Tell the press?

cards.comment:
Firewolf can't do the gig because they don't have any instruments!
	At first they say the gear was stolen, but after a while Andy Rokks admits he sold it all to buy drugs. Of course, the rest of the band are furious.
	Andy doesn't want to talk about it because he's been feeling really tired lately.
	Andy shall have to buy the gear back, but now the concert is in jeopardy.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Firewolf Have no Gear
cards.Caption: Sold for Dope
cards.question: Cancel show or buy new gear ($5000)?

cards.comment: Eddie St. Johns says he needs a custom made case for the champagne bottle he opens after every show. It might break without it.\n\tThe custom made case will set you back $2000.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Eddie Wants Special Case
cards.Caption: Fragile
cards.question: Pay for the case?

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette wonders why Firewolf's record sales are so bad.\n\tShe thinks that you should buy some more adverts and arrange a gig in the Record Store.\n\tAnette thinks that Firewolf are much better than most bands on the Top 10, and wants to know why aren't they listed.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette Disappointed with Sales
cards.Caption: Anette
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf are ready for a world tour. She wonders if you are really the right manager for them if you can't arrange a world tour.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette Demands Tour
cards.Caption: Anette
cards.question: What do you say?

cards.comment: Eddie St. Johns has had it with Anette's constant nagging, criticism and opinions. He can't stand her, put simply.\n\tNow Eddie wants you to tell Sonny that he must choose between Anette and Firewolf.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Eddie St. Johns Fed up with Anette
cards.Caption: Fed up with nagging
cards.question: Give Sonny the ultimatum?

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> has a few specific requests for the next gig.\n\tThe dressing room is to have a temperature of exactly 21ºC at least an hour before Firewolf arrive, otherwise he can't warm up his vocal cords properly.\n\t<¤CRealMusician.firstname> also wants a bowl of alphabet crackers in his dressing room. But only the letter A.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Eddie St. Johns Demands Special Treatment
cards.Caption: Spoiled?
cards.question: Meet Eddie's demands?

cards.comment: Andy Rokks has been arrested. In his apartment was found controlled substances worth thousands.\n\tAlso, there was a metal hatch in his front door. Looks like Andy had another job on the side.\n\tAnyway, now he's gonna have to go to court, but he is out on bail until the trial.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Drug Accusations
cards.Caption: Dealer?
cards.question: Tell the press?

cards.comment: Spotlight Tours call to offer their services as a tour promoter for your artists. It is Firewolf's good sales lately that has sparked their interest.
cards.name: World Tour
cards.Headline: Spotlight Tours Offer
cards.question: Visit Spotlight to book tour

cards.comment: Douglas of City News calls to find out why the band hasn't split up yet. You told him the rumors where true.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Request Comment
cards.Caption: In doubt
cards.question: What do you tell him?

mission.comment: Poor Nick Chesterton can't stand the pressure but returns to the fray like a duck to water.
mission.name: Kind of Blue
mission.IntroText: Your mission is to make as much money as possible out of the talents of Nick Chesterton whose debut album "So Much Pain, So Little Hope" was a unanimous favourite with the critics.\n   The attention was too much for Nick, who fled the limelight. Now a few years have passed and Nick is ready for a comeback.\n   With expectations high Nick may not make it so fleece him before he shuns the limelight and flees the biz.
mission.SucceedText: So he gave up at last? Well, it was only a question of time before that would happen.\n   Nick Chesterton is a double nature, as much as he hates attention he can't live without music.\n   He'll be back again surely, but by then you'll be busy with bigger things. Anyway, you made some dough from this little adventure.
mission.FailText: Yeah? The set up was perfect. You had the press AND the public on your side. Everybody wanted a piece of Nick Chesterton.\n   It should have been an easy stroll to the Rock 'n' Roll Hall of Fame, but you couldn't even handle that.\n   Try again, and don't spend your money so quickly this time around.
mission.CriteriaText:
 Hire Musicians for Nick's Band 
 Record a Demo 
 Release Record 
 Sell 30,000 Copies Before Nick Quits Pop

cards.comment: Zer0 Magazine wants an interview with Nick Chesterton.\n\tHis comeback is a big thing among their readers and Zer0 think the interview would help you promote the record.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Magazine Request Interview
cards.Caption: Excited
cards.question: Give them the interview?

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton finds out you've set him up for an interview with Zer0 Magazine, but there's just no chance he's gonna do an interview.\n\tHe has made perfectly clear that he wants nothing to do with the media.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Refuses Interview
cards.Caption: No way, José
cards.question: He won't do it

cards.comment: Nick asks how long it's gonna take before you release a record.\n\tAll this indecision is making him doubt his comeback. He's just not sure whether he can do it or not.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Growing Restless
cards.Caption: Cold feet
cards.question: Nick is getting uneasy

cards.comment: After a few days on his holiday, Nick Chesterton is recognised by fans and reporters at the resort.\n\tHe escapes to his bungalow, but they wait outside and Nick is worried they might touch the room service meals he orders before he can eat them.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Harrassed by Fans and Media
cards.Caption: No rest
cards.question: The holiday wasn't all that relaxing

cards.comment: The liquor you gave Nick Chesterton has made him really ill.\n\tHe can barely speak, much less sing, and spends all day in his room with the blinds shut, plucking absent-mindedly on his guitar between the vomiting fits.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Takes Ill
cards.Caption: Not too good with booze
cards.question: Nick is ill

cards.comment: As you exit the studio, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside. Somebody must have leaked to the press that Nick was recording in <¤CPlace.name>.\n\tThey all want a piece of Nick and you have to fight to get him out of there.\n\tNick is really shaken by the incident and doubts if the comeback was such a good idea after all.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Incident Shakes Nick
cards.Caption: Shaken, not stirred
cards.question: Nick's mood worsened

cards.comment: As you exit the studio, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside. Somebody must have leaked to the press that Nick was recording in <¤CPlace.name>.\n\tThe Spektor bodyguards elegantly smuggle him out through an air shaft to escape the reporters. Problem solved.\n\tSome papers run admiring accounts of the movie-style escape.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Avoided by Bodyguards
cards.Caption: Got away clean
cards.question: Sergey's bodyguards did their thing

cards.comment:
There is a  huge media posse waiting outside the concert hall after the show.
	You try to wait them out, but they persist. You have to fight your way through a wall of reporter flesh!
	They don't even bother asking any questions, they just grab at Nick for a piece of hair, skin or clothes.
	Finally, you get away with Nick in disarray and bruises all over his body.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Attack Nick
cards.Caption: Treated roughly
cards.question: Nick is disturbed

cards.comment: As you exit concert, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside for you.\n\tThe Spektor bodyguards set off the fire alarm and sneak Nick out the back door, unseen by any reporter in the midst of the confusion.\n\tSomebody must have leaked the escape to the press because City News and Zer0 Magazine both print admiring descriptions of the daring escape.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Avoided by Bodyguards
cards.Caption: Got away clean
cards.question: Sergey's men sorted it out

cards.comment: After the concert, the hungry media anxiously waits to get a piece of Nick Chesterton.\n\tAs he tries to wade through the crowd, the pressure becomes too much and Nick collapses on the ground.\n\tWhen the ambulance arrives, the reporters have already left to write their pieces on celebrity hysteria, media ethics and low security at concerts.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Attack Nick
cards.Caption: Collapsed
cards.question: Nick will recover in a few days

cards.comment: After the concert, hungry reporters anxiously wait to get a piece of your star.\n\tThe paparazzi refuse to back down until the Spektor bodyguards pull out their guns and threaten to fire at will. That does the trick -  you can leave safely!\n\tSome media report on the incident, making Nick feel very awkward.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Avoided by Bodyguards
cards.Caption: Safe but disturbed
cards.question: Nick is feeling uneasy

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is angry with you because you hired <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>.\n\tHe can't play with such heavy metal freaks. His music has nuances that metal heads can't even begin to fathom and if you can't understand it, then how could you play it?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Unhappy with Musician
cards.Caption: No, seriously
cards.question: Nick wants rid of <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is angry with you for not having fired <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>. He is unsure if he can trust you anymore.\n\tIf you don't hire and fire the musicians he chooses, how can he trust you with the press?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Questions Manager
cards.Caption: Do what I say!
cards.question: Nick wants rid of <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is furious that you would schedule him for a video shoot.\n\tHe refuses to ever appear in any video! That goes against everything that Nick Chesterton is about.\n\tYou can cancel the shoot or make it without him.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Refuses Video Shoot
cards.Caption: No! No! No!
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: <missionVar.Mis6Booredmusician.name> is fed up with Nick Chesterton's egoism and eccentricity.\n\tIt's so boring working with somebody who spends half the days just dealing with his neurosis.\n\tNo great music is being made.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Artist Bored
cards.Caption: Cooperation difficulties
cards.question: Criticism against Nick

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is very upset that you would set him up for an interview, knowing about his feelings towards the media.\n\tHe refuses to be interviewed.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Refuses Interview
cards.Caption: No-can-do
cards.question: You should know better!

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton has managed to sell 30.000 copies and made enough money to creep back into the abyss where he used to dwell.\n\tThere's nothing more you can do for him and he's gonna be happier this way anyhow.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Retires
cards.Caption: Leaving the limelight
cards.question: Mission over

cards.comment: The music industry yearly Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies are coming up.\n\tAmong the nominees for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar is Nick Chesterton. With the nomination comes an offer to play a song live at the ceremonies which will be held in a week.\n\tThe promoters demand you pay $10.000 to do the gig, but it's great promotion.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Gold Wiener Nomination
cards.Caption: The Gold Wiener
cards.question: Do the gig?

cards.comment:
After an outstanding performance at the Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies, Nick Chesterton receives the Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar.
	The stage instantly fills with languishing teens out to get Nick's autograph, T-shirt and virginity (not necessarily in that order).
	The Spektor bodyguards swiftly disperse the crowd by playing heavy metal over the PA at a painful volume.
	Nick escapes unharmed, but spends half an hour telling you how he feels about heavy metal.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Wins Gold Wiener
cards.Caption: Prize winner
cards.question: Nick won the award!

cards.comment: After an outstanding performance at the Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies, Nick Chesterton receives the Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar.\n\tThe stage instantly fills with languishing teens out to get Nick's autograph, t-shirt and virginity (not necessarily in that order).\n\tAt first Nick is thrilled, but it's not long before he panics and runs screaming off the stage.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Wins Gold Wiener
cards.Caption: Prize winner
cards.question: Nick won the award!

cards.comment: You attend the Gold Wiener Awards, but Nick doesn't win anything.\n\tThe Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar goes to Eric Flanders, who played at the gala and is overjoyed as the stage fills with teenage fans wanting to celebrate his genius.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Eric Flanders Wins Gold Wiener
cards.Caption: Nick didn't get it
cards.question: You can't win them all, right?

cards.comment: Start over and think twice about your expenses. Do you really need to use the most expensive studios and gear?
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Your number one priority should be to keep Nick in the band!
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Nick is torn to pieces because you have considered recording a song other than his masterpiece, Mountain of Hypocrisy.\n\tThe only thing Nick ever wanted to do was make his music  the reason why he puts up with media madness.\n\tHe immediately goes back to his cocoon with the intent to stay there forever.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Giving Up
cards.Caption: Back to hibernation
cards.question: Game over
